senses.gloss:
व्ये व्ये (i. e. वि-इ), i. 1, Par. Ātm. To cover.
 --Ptcple. pf. pass. वित, placed, bound, Vikr. d. 157.
 --With [] the prep. आ आ, आवीत, Enveloped, Bhāg. P. 3, 31, 4.
 --With उप उप, उपवीत, n. The cord worn by the three first classes of the Hindus over the left and under the right shoulder, Man. 2, 44.
 --Comp.
 --With नि नि, निवीत, n. The brahmanical thread suspended round the neck, in which manner it is worn on some occasions.
 --With परि परि, परिवीत,
 1. Surrounded, Kir. 5, 42; invested.
 2. Covered, clothed, Ragh. 15, 77 (Calc.).
 3. Overspread, pervaded. n. The bow of Brahman.
 --With सम् सम्, संवीत,
 1. Surrounded.
 2. Covered, Rām. 3, 50, 12.
 3. Clothed, Rām. 3, 52, 9.
 4. Adorned, Rām. 3, 52, 30.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἱ in ἱμάτιον.
